wiki_article: **THE MACRO-MAQUETTE: SEED** is a mixed creative work by Lee Sharks dated 18 February 2026. A **maquette** is a small model made to work out a larger structure, and the seed is the compressed form of the compendium held at **#1324** — a 104,354-character *Compendium of Micro-Physics for the Crimson Hexagonal Architecture*. The archive deposits compression and original as separate records on the principle that a compressed form is a distinct object rather than a summary of another. The two records stand in a same-version relation the SAMEVER scan flagged for adjudication: the arrow between them may run in either direction, since a seed can precede a compendium or be extracted from one. The record was assembled from a DataCite full-metadata capture after the 19 June 2026 termination, with no live authorial surface available at restoration time. The record was held as a metadata capture until 8 August 2026, when the canonical text was recovered from the authorial blog surface and seated as the body.

full_version_withdrawn.why: WRONG. Round 1 pointed this capture at #493 on a shared hex coordinate and four shared DOIs. The authoritative doi-resolution-index maps this record's OWN severed DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18683024 — titled THE MACRO-MAQUETTE: SEED — to /s/records/1325/, direct_verified. #493 owns 10.5281/zenodo.18604123, THE MINI MACRO-MAQUETTE MAQUETTE: SEED, which is a different work in the same series. The shared hex and the overlapping DOI lists are REFERENCES between siblings, not evidence of identity: registry zenodo_dois fields list DOIs a record cites as well as any it owns, and 128 first-position DOIs in that field are claimed by more than one record. I confirmed a pairing on evidence that cannot distinguish citing from being.
